description_en: Calls the CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment operation to connect a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance to a transit router instance for private network peering. After the connection is established, the transit router instance can help you achieve private network peering
description_zh: 调用CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment接口将要互通的专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例连接至转发路由器实例。连接后，转发路由器实例可以帮助您实现私网互通
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-transit-router-vpc-attachment --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1kbjcre9vtsebo10000 --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-h VSwitchId=vsw-bp1a214sbus8z3b540000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTransitRouterVpcAttachment

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router
parameters.help_zh: 企业版转发路由器实例ID
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC-connected instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPC connection.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the VPC connection.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
VPC连接的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_description

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the VPC-connected instance belongs. The default value is the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the current logon user.

This parameter is required if you want to load a cross-account network instance
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。默认值为当前登录的阿里云账号ID。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method. Default value: POSTPAY, which indicates pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 付费方式。默认值：POSTPAY，表示按量付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute a dry run, including permission and instance status verification. Valid values:

false (default): Sends a normal request and creates the VPC connection after the request passes the check.
true: Sends a check request. Only the check is performed, and the VPC connection is not created. The check items include whether required parameters are specified and the request format. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。取值：

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建VPC连接。
true：发送检查请求，只进行校验，不会创建VPC连接。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch instance in a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can select vSwitch instances for up to 10 zones at a time
fields.help_zh:
在企业版转发路由器支持的可用区中选择一个交换机实例。

一次最多支持为10个可用区选择交换机实例
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html operation to query zone IDs.

You can select up to 10 zones at a time
fields.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器支持的可用区的ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html接口查询可用区的ID。

一次最多支持选择10个可用区
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
Select a vSwitch instance in a zone supported by the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can add up to 10 entries at a time
parameters.help_zh:
请在企业版转发路由器的可用区中选择一个交换机实例。

一次最多支持添加10组信息
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the Enterprise Edition transit router to automatically publish routing entries to the VPC instance.

false (default): No.
true: Yes
parameters.help_zh:
是否使企业版转发路由器自动发布路由到VPC实例。

false（默认值）：否。
true：是
parameters.name: auto_publish_route_enabled

parameters.help_en: The list of feature attributes for the VPC connection (to be deprecated, use the new parameter Options instead)
parameters.help_zh: VPC连接的功能属性列表（即将废弃，请使用新入参 Options）
parameters.name: transit_router_vpc_attachment_options

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

Once specified, the tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https:// `。

一次最多支持输入20个标签的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.

Once specified, the tag value cannot be empty. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。

一旦传入该值，则不允许为空。支持输入不超过 128 个字符的字符串，不能以 aliyun 或者 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或者 https:// 。

每一个标签键对应一个标签值，一次最多支持输入 20 个标签键对应的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

You can specify up to 20 tags at a time
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

一次最多支持输入20个标签信息
parameters.name: tag

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the appliance mode.

disable (default): No.
enable: Yes
fields.help_zh:
是否开启网元导流模式。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是
fields.name: appliance_mode_support

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether IPv6 is supported.

disable (default): No.
enable: Yes
fields.help_zh:
是否支持IPv6。

disable（默认值）：否。
enable：是
fields.name: ipv6_support
